description: Reduce backend chat latency from 6-7s to under 2-3s by optimizing AI client timeouts, model selection, RAG graceful degradation, response caching, and connection warm-up
steps: Step 1 - Switch Vertex AI default model from gemini-1.5-pro to gemini-2.0-flash-lite in apps/backend/app/config.py (change VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL default). gemini-2.0-flash-lite is Google's fastest model with sub-second TTFB. If that is not available, use gemini-2.0-flash.

Step 2 - Reduce AI client timeouts in apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py: Change from httpx.Timeout(60.0, connect=10.0) to httpx.Timeout(15.0, connect=5.0). Same for sarvam_client.py. These are chat responses, not batch jobs - 15s is plenty.

Step 3 - Reduce max_tokens for non-streaming generate calls. In vertex_client.py, change maxOutputTokens from 1024 to 512. In sarvam_client.py, change max_tokens from 1024 to 512. This cuts generation time roughly in half while still allowing meaningful responses.

Step 4 - Add a RAG timeout with fast-fail in apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py retrieve_context method: Wrap the search call in asyncio.wait_for with a 2-second timeout. If it times out or fails, return empty list immediately. This prevents RAG from blocking the critical path.

Step 5 - Add response caching for the non-streaming /chat endpoint. In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, add a new static method cached_generate that checks Redis for a cache key based on hash(sanitized_message + detected_lang). Cache hits return immediately (target: <100ms). Cache TTL should be 10 minutes. Only cache when context_chunks is empty (since RAG is dynamic).

Step 6 - Warm up Vertex AI token at startup in apps/backend/app/main.py lifespan function. After Azure Search warm-up, add: from app.services.ai.vertex_client import vertex_client; await vertex_client._get_access_token(). This pre-fetches the OAuth token so the first request doesn't pay the token refresh penalty.

Step 7 - Make rate limit check run in parallel with language detection + input sanitization in apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py. Currently rate limit completes before _process_chat starts. Move rate_limit to run concurrently with the initial setup work using asyncio.gather or by moving it inside _process_chat alongside the RAG gather.

Step 8 - Add a fast-path short-circuit in apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py search_context method: If self.client is None, return [] immediately without attempting Redis cache lookup (saves a round-trip when search is unconfigured).
Step 9 - Reduce the Vertex AI circuit breaker reset_timeout from 60s to 30s in apps/backend/app/core/circuit_breaker.py, so recovery is faster after transient failures.

Step 10 - Add concise system prompt option: In chat_service.py build_system_prompt, reduce the system prompt length when context_chunks is empty. Use a shorter instruction (2-3 sentences max) to reduce prompt tokens and speed up LLM inference.
acceptance_criteria: VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL default is gemini-2.0-flash-lite in config.py
Vertex client timeout is 15s total, 5s connect
Sarvam client timeout is 15s total, 5s connect
max_tokens for non-streaming is 512 in both vertex and sarvam clients
Response caching logic exists and checks Redis before calling LLM
Vertex AI OAuth token is pre-fetched at startup in lifespan
Azure Search returns [] immediately when client is None without Redis lookup
Circuit breaker reset_timeout for Vertex AI is 30s
System prompt is shorter when no RAG context is available
Existing tests still pass (no breaking changes to API contract)
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q to confirm all tests pass
Grep for the new timeout values to confirm they were applied
Grep for gemini-2.0-flash-lite in config.py to confirm model switch
findings: All 10 steps implemented successfully. Post-review fixes applied: (1) Moved cache check AFTER rate limit enforcement to prevent rate-limit bypass on cache hits. (2) Replaced try/except around asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True for proper per-task error isolation. (3) Added code comment explaining cache key tradeoff (no user/session in key). Syntax verified via AST parsing. Cannot run tests due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (httpx not installed).
